# Scholars' Choice

> > Singapore's comprehensive scholarship discovery platform connecting students with 100+ government, institutional, and private sector scholarship opportunities.

Scholars' Choice is a dedicated scholarship portal for Singapore that aggregates opportunities from major providers including A*STAR, government agencies (MHA, IRAS, MAS), educational institutions (NTU), and private organizations. The platform combines searchable listings with real scholar experiences and expert guidance to help students navigate Singapore's diverse funding landscape.

## Key Topics

- Singapore scholarships
- Government scholarships
- Scholarship search
- Scholar interviews
- A*STAR
- Scholarship providers
- Student testimonials

- Education funding
- Singapore education
- Sponsorship database
- Study opportunities
- NTU
- Singapore Maritime Foundation
- Qualification-based funding

## Scholarship Discovery

- [Singapore Top Scholarship Programs](https://www.scholarschoice.com.sg): Homepage featuring 100+ Singapore scholarships with deadlines, applications, and expert tips.
- [Scholarships List & Opportunities](https://www.scholarschoice.com.sg/opportunities): Comprehensive searchable database of Singapore scholarships from government and institutions.

## Scholarship Providers

- [Directory of Singapore Scholarship Providers](https://www.scholarschoice.com.sg/providers): Directory of Singapore scholarship providers from government, public, and private sectors.

## Scholar Insights & Experiences

- [Scholars' Experience: Interviews & Advice](https://www.scholarschoice.com.sg/scholars-experience): Scholar interviews and practical advice from public and private sector award recipients.
